topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The rain's been coming down like it's got a grudge. Neighbor down the block, what’s-his-name, decided now’s the perfect time to throw up a fence. Like a wall, you know? Keeps out the rain, maybe, but what else? Iffen you ask me, ain’t no fence gonna keep the real trouble at bay. He’s all polite, brings over a slice of pie, talks about privacy and property lines. But I've seen that look before, the one that hides a few too many secrets. I nod, take the pie, and promise to think it over. Thinking's free, after all, and right now, that’s about all I can afford.
